capabilities: Set per-item icons via context menu or a fuzzy-searchable picker stored in frontmatter
Apply rule-based icons matching path prefix, extension, name, tag, or regex
Assign default icons by file type (images, audio, video, PDF, canvas, code, archives, spreadsheets)
Show icons in tab headers, inline titles, and reading-view links
Color icons deterministically and switch between bundled icon packs
disambiguation: Not an icon library or emoji picker; it decorates vault files and folders in the explorer rather than providing icons for note content.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Icon packs (Unicons, Cuida, Material Symbols) are bundled at build time; the plugin makes no network requests.
motivation: The README frames the plugin as adding icons to the explorer 'no manual tagging of every item required', implying manual effort was the pain point.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows only plain file and folder names, so telling items apart at a glance requires manually labeling each one.
summary: Icon decorator that automatically adds icons to files and folders in the file explorer based on frontmatter, rules, tags, and file type.
